english.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something that can cause death or is lethal.

exampleSentences.english: This kind of venom may be deadly if it touches your skin.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種毒液掂到皮膚就可能致命。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zung2 duk6 jik6 dim3 dou2 pei4 fu1 zau6 ho2 nang4 zi3 ming6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes death or disastrous damage, including a fatal wound or mistake.

exampleSentences.english: That traffic accident caused a fatal injury.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰場交通意外造成致命傷。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 coeng4 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 zou6 sing4 zi3 ming6 soeng1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that causes death, especially a wound or injury.

exampleSentences.english: A bite from this snake can be mortal.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種蛇嘅咬傷可以致命。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zung2 se4 ge3 ngaau5 soeng1 ho2 ji5 zi3 ming6
